 George Pickens Drops Viral Quote Updating Injury Status for Cowboys vs. 49ers amid Hamstring Issue
 Adam Wells Nov 13, 2026 After missing Week 9 due to a hamstring injury, George Pickens had a unique way of letting everyone know he plans to be back for Sunday's marquee matchup featuring the Dallas Cowboys hosting the San Francisco 49ers. 
 Asked after Friday's practice if he will be on the field, Pickens had this response: "Tell your wife or your girl to turn the TV on, and she'll see me on the field."

 Bleacher Report 2d The Cowboys listed Pickens as a limited practice participant on Wednesday and Thursday. He originally popped up on the injury report with an unspecified issue in Week 7, but he played the next two games. 
 Things got to the point where Pickens was unable to go against the Indianapolis Colts. Dallas survived without him in a 27-23 win thanks to CeeDee Lamb's 195-yard effort. 
 It certainly sounds like Pickens will be back as the Cowboys look to get a much-needed win against a 49ers team that currently sits atop the NFC standings with a 7-1 record.
